scope: 1280 historical student responses; no GPU work; labels from existing 16-case exploratory review
causal_zlib: window_end, not window_start; stride-aligned full windows only; final unaligned window cannot save tokens
step_rule: paragraphs until first complete Step heading, then completed heading blocks; only heading ordinal and whitespace normalized; history32; minimum64 tokens per block; short/new blocks reset streak
decoder: Qwen byte-level sampled IDs mapped incrementally to chars; matches all 1280 saved output strings including trailing incomplete Unicode suppression
auc: 9 positive reviewed loop/late_loop records and 1 normal_progress negative; 6 uncertain excluded; selection intentionally includes native detector misses; NOT representative
grading: project math verifier on retained actual sampled-token prefixes; correctness changes are not semantic false-positive counts
